title: TradeSignal
description: domain::types::TradeSignal, produced by strategy::generate_signal once a divergence resolves to a concrete pair and passes the True Open gate.

trace_id.description: Correlates this signal through to whatever order, position, or rejection it leads to.

pair.description: The resolved concrete pair: whichever of primary/secondary strategy::smt::TradeTarget identified as the asset that held (the one to trade), not necessarily the pair-set's configured 'primary'.

tier.description: Tier1: daily timeframe only. Tier2: session timeframe only. Double: both timeframes agree on both target and direction; triggers the 2x risk multiplier.

originating_snapshot_id.description: Ties this signal back to the specific BrokerSnapshot it was computed from.
